title: THE ARENA replaces THE BOSS: the Nih-Dairia out of a giant opening far from the base, small Reeds and Nih-Dairia pups before it, Isao driving the hull as the lure (toward the arena, kiting the quarry, off the gunship's and SOL's blasts), the player's long gunship session; the arena's hole stays open as the nest's mouth the descent goes down
context: The owner's third round, notes 7, 11 and 12: 'sector 9 wave cutis; there was a misunderstanding, the set-up is supposed to be a giant opening very far from the base, with a giant Nih Daira creature ... The autopilot will be Isao driving around and avoiding both the monster and friendly fire, as the user shoots from above in a longer gunship session'; 'both should have their place on the planet'; 'some small REEDs and small NiDaira emerge here and there in the early waves, new type of enemies, then a GIANT ONE emerges ... the tank acts as LURE, while the gunship fires from above'. THE BOSS of 2026-10-15 (the Cutis-Maku and twenty small Cutis up the gate lane, the hull on avoid) was the wrong creature in the wrong place; its machinery (the row, the choice card, src/fx/boss-run.js, the hunter plans, the strip row, the harness) is kept. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-arena-design.md, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-16-arena.md.
outcome: story.arena = { cell, hops } is chosen with the world (src/platform/story-world.js, src/domain/arena.js pickArenaCell: the farthest reachable cell outside the walls within ARENA.farHops 4 of the farthest; ?arena=<cell> names one). ARENA_SECTOR (src/content/sectors.js; BOSS_SECTOR is its alias for the arc) at doorAt+1: breaches { arena: 1 } on that cell, ARENA.craterCells 3 wide (src/game-breaches.js create(..., cells): the sinkhole scaled whole, the craters and the lip read the width), kept open at SECURE (spent, not sealed; keep: no closer takes it); boss { family 'reed', waves [12 small Reeds at 4 hp, 6 NIH-DAIRIA · PUP at 6 hp], boss { huge, 180 } } as hunter plans (src/domain/boss-sector.js bossWaves: one plan a wave). The pup is a fifth Reed tier (CREATURE_TIERS.reed.pup, r0 3.5, variant nih-dairia) and HUNTERS.mix alternates small Reed / pup from sector 5. The lure: the `lure` directive (src/fx/hull-drive.js on src/domain/lure.js, LURE near 5 / far 10 / blast 4): no quarry, the arena's walking field; the quarry (the boss once up, else the nearest hunter, at its body's point) kited under near, closed on past far, circled between; no exit within blast cells of a danger point (the MK-9's painted, falling or diving cell and the shells in the air from the gunship rig, SOL's burn point from the laser arsenal) while another remains; boss-run re-asserts it every frame as it did avoid. The rows and the callout take the family's label (NIH-DAIRIA). Lines: boss_rises 'That is not a wave. That is the nest's mother.', arena_lure at the first shot from the seat; the voice list's section 16 amended (seiyu_voice dae36e7). The descent's brief names the arena's hole and the camera looks at it DESCENT.lookHold 2.5 s before the cave opens. Harness: state().arena, state().boss.tiers; browser --arena (the old --boss-sector). Out: the Nih-Dairia's fear and stun from the guns, a carcass, difficulty beyond the counts.
alternatives: A new sector module beside boss-run: the run's shape (the choice, the seat, the lines, the restore) is the same; only the creature, the place and the drive changed.
The avoid directive with the hull parked at the base: the boss would walk to the base; the owner wants it kept far out, so the hull goes to it and kites.
A separate hole for the descent: one opening is the nest's mouth; the arena's stays open and the descent looks at it.
evidence: test/arena.mjs, test/lure.mjs, test/boss-sector.mjs, test/sectors.mjs, test/sector-run.mjs (the arena breach's cell, width, keep and survival), test/creature-ramp.mjs, test/controller-copy.mjs, test/hull-drive.mjs (the wanderer's hash unchanged), test/host-contracts.mjs; browser --boss-start --arena --descent
